purpose: Bind repository files, symbols, imports, dependencies, ownership, tests and trace impact into one freshness-aware code-intelligence contract.

masterplan_binding.title: Code Intelligence
required_gap_texts: connect ownership/test mapping to change planner

freshness_policy.identity: source Git blob identities plus repository HEAD
stale_when: any bound source Git blob changes
repository HEAD changes without index regeneration
freshness_policy.heuristic_rule: Heuristic import/dependency inference carries confidence metadata and never becomes ownership or authority truth.
freshness_policy.generated_vendor_rule: Generated/vendor/satellite content must be classified separately and cannot pollute canonical dependency confidence.

impact_policy.rule: Change planning combines code edges, semantic ownership, mapped tests and trace impact; missing mappings remain explicit unknowns.
